criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Most frames bold and staged; slide 2 encodes the data honestly (126, 108, 81 counted). Slide 8 mannequin figure, wheel apart with nobody behind it, flat grey windshield. Slide 3 bottom third near-black blurred bodies. Slide 5 grey mid tones with no bright edge. Slide 6 skyline flat blocks, slide 9 hair cards.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One lot, one low key, one limestone stand-in, one dusk_gold stripe that keeps its meaning; motif changes state; values dark. Slide 8 a different world with interior light.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and derived figures check. Slide 8's picture reads as a passenger beside an empty wheel, opposite of c62 and c64. c68 (Kodiak's Permian trucks with no one in the cab since December 2024) is verified and left out while slide 8 frames people still sitting up front. Slides 1 and 9 link the summary report to authorizations on c43's link title and filename rather than words in the report.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who decides, the instrument, the record, Dallas's refused request, the enforcement line and an action. No deadline or open proceeding; slide 6 drops the Chapter 552 answer in c52.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 2 pays at once, turn at 5 and 6, close on an action. 3 and 4 both work the tail; 9's last sentence closes on housekeeping.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, on register. Machine meta-copy on 4 (It draws as the lot's last car), 2 (rounded, and never fewer than one) and 9's closing sentence.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fourth AV deck in 30 days (nos. 52, 59, 67); no. 52 drew a full model among many on a dark lot, no. 67 ranks of tractors; Charger lane appears in no. 67; house lastLight and one-unit-per-N scale. Roster as a parking lot is fresh.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild slide 8 so the seated person is plainly behind the wheel with the road visible, and add c68's verified line that Kodiak's Permian trucks have run with no one in the cab since December 2024.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Wheel alone at frame right with nobody behind it, mannequin figure slumped at left, flat grey windshield; reads as a passenger beside an empty wheel.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera in the passenger seat looking across so the driver sits directly behind the wheel, hands on the rim, windshield open to the road and seam.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Bottom third near-black soft-focus car bodies; leaders end on rows too dark to confirm.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Raise and tilt the camera so the third column's rows fill the lower 60 percent with Avride's lit rows nearest; pin labels to each run's white divider.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Relief in one grey mid band; no raking light, no bright edge.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the key to a low grazing angle so groove walls catch highlights and the stop block throws a long cast; keep the mat near black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Car and pedestrian small and far apart in a dark field; figure flat-lit; stop bar doesn't read.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower the camera to the crosswalk and push in so nose, stop bar and figure share the middle third.
